title: Honest Abstention Transfer in Small-Corpus Supervised Fine-Tuning: Measured Refusals and Confabulations in a 4B Estate-Tuned Model
description: Preprint. Measures abstention transfer in a production 4B estate-tuned model with an 8-probe held-out suite. Reports verbatim: correct refusals for unmeasured-value probes and confabulated citations on citation-shaped probes. Characterizes the refusal/confabulation asymmetry and defines an eval-driven DPO counterweight protocol built from the measured failures.
notes: Not peer reviewed. Companion receipts in SZLHOLDINGS/model-eval-receipts.
